events.detail: 00-spec.yaml declares risk: medium and quorum analyze risk-score calculated medium (file_count_high: 9). No divergence event emitted; 00-spec.yaml was not modified.

hsme-cli search-fuzzy returned INTERNAL_ERROR (failed to open database: no such file or directory); SQLITE_DB_PATH is not configured in this environment. Advisory-only per ADR 0008, so the blueprint proceeded without semantic carry-over.
.ai/tasks/failed/ is empty, so quorum analyze failure-lookup returned null and contributed no prior-failure lessons to the risks array.

quorum analyze blueprint-context returned the seed set unchanged (no additional ast_neighbors or import_graph files), so the affected_files set was determined by direct verification against the codebase.

Verified against 0002-saldo-y-movimientos.sql: movimientos CHECK (monto <> 0) line 47 forces suppressing a zero-delta conciliacion movement; saldo CHECK (disponible >= 0) line 17 and CHECK (reservado >= 0) line 18 drive the capped-deficit and estado='activa' guard decisions; movimientos CHECK (saldo_resultante >= 0) line 48. PoolDeSesiones serializes writes through a single Mutex<Connection> (pools.rs line 103). ProcesadorDeInferencia discards the reservation id today (procesador.rs line 116). RespuestaDeInferencia has exactly three construction sites, all inside crates/hexcell. hexcell-storage/src/lib.rs line 58 must re-export the new enum.

Spec delegated three open decisions to the blueprint. (a) Deficit: charge capped at current disponible, uncovered remainder returned as deficit_no_cubierto and logged, not written to movimientos (no 'perdida' clase exists and migrations are a non-goal). (b) Timeout: none introduced; a provider timeout surfaces as Err and takes the liberar path, with the real timeout deferred to task 9. (c) Metadata: unidades_consumidas is a total u64, not Option, so no missing-metadata policy is invented here.

summary: Post-execution reconciliation of budget reservations: surplus return, capped deficit charge, release on provider failure, wired into ProcesadorDeInferencia per ADR-0005 phase 2.
